title: The 10 Countries with the Highest Urban Population (2024)
description: Which countries lead the world in urban population? See the top 10 (and the bottom of the table) for 2024, measured in % of population.
author: World of Maps
html:
Over half of humanity now lives in cities—urbanization has doubled since 1950. Across 217 countries with 2024 data, Bahrain tops the table for urban population at 100%, while Liechtenstein sits at the bottom on 14.7%.

The top 10

  1. Bahrain — 100%
  2. Bermuda — 100%
  3. Cayman Islands — 100%
  4. Gibraltar — 100%
  5. Hong Kong SAR, China — 100%
  6. Kuwait — 100%
  7. Macao SAR, China — 100%
  8. Monaco — 100%
  9. Nauru — 100%
  10. Singapore — 100%

At the other end of the table

  • Liechtenstein — 14.7%
  • Papua New Guinea — 15.4%
  • Malawi — 17.3%

What the numbers show

The global average sits at about 62.9%, with 113 of 217 countries above it and a median of 63.9%. Bahrain reports roughly 6.8× the figure of Liechtenstein — a reminder of how unevenly urbanisation is spread.
